topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It’s been years since I last saw Jason. We promised to be lifelong friends, but life took us different ways. I decided to surprise him after finding out he moved back to town. Walking up to him, it felt like no time had passed. But something was off. His eyes didn’t light up; there was no instant recognition. He said he was sorry, didn’t have the foggiest idea who I was. It’s strange, how the memories I’ve cherished for so long didn’t stick with him at all. Talking to him, I felt a weight in my chest, making it hard to breathe. I tried to stay light, sharing old stories, but it was clear they were new to him. I ended our conversation with a weak smile, promising to catch up another time, though I’m not sure I want to.
